summary: Viskase Holdings (formerly Enzon Pharmaceuticals) filed an 8-K disclosing adoption of a Section 382 Rights Agreement (poison pill) to preserve net operating loss carryforwards. The board declared a dividend of one Right per share, exercisable at $30 per one-thousandth of a Series A-2 Preferred share. The pill is triggered by a 4.9% beneficial ownership threshold without board approval, with existing 4.9% holders grandfathered. This NOL-protection plan is a defensive shareholder rights mechanism, not a transaction. No acquisition, divestiture, or other event-driven special situation is present. Watch for any subsequent 13D filings indicating activist accumulation or waiver requests, though no risk-arb angle exists here.
